title: Blue Note
description: A record sleeve in the manner of Reid Miles: two inks on warm board, a duotone photograph from Let It Be and the title set huge in heavy Geist, cropped hard against the edges. Drag inside the square and the layout re-composes in big moves, the type scaling, turning and running off the edge, then settling on springs into the nearest of six finished sleeves.
intent: Reference: Reid Miles' Blue Note covers (Unit Structures, Out to Lunch, The Freedom Rider, Hub-Tones), https://readymag.com/designstories/reid-miles/never-settle-into-typeface. Scale, crop and two-ink overprint do the swinging; every resting state is a finished sleeve.
